claims.claim: Inference-backed checks (audio_emotion, image_moderation, text_toxicity, topic_policy) call one interface, inference.Provider, with Infer(ctx, Request) (Response, error)
Request fields Model, Inputs []types.Message, Labels, Prompt, Params; Response has Scores []LabelScore{Label, Score}, highest first, plus Model, Usage, Raw
audio_emotion with expected_label reads that label's score; topic_policy compares on-topic with off-topic
Audio and image checks deliver media as an inline part on the first input message; audio arrives at the target rate (16 kHz mono), provider owns decode/normalize, not resampling
WithClassifier(id, provider) registers an instance with no credential resolution; reports inference metrics
inference.RegisterFactory(type, func(spec inference.ProviderSpec) (inference.Provider, error)) plus sdk.WithInferenceProvider(sdk.ProviderSpec{ID, Type, Model}); spec.Model, spec.AdditionalConfig
A type names one vendor API
Pack declares requires.providers key/role inference/description/required; check params.provider names the key; the bound ID is the logical name
A check whose name is undeclared, unbound or bound to the wrong kind fails Open and says which
Observe results with sdk.WithEvalHook or a metrics recorder
onnx-audio-emotion example implements inference.Provider with ONNX wav2vec2, registers via WithClassifier, scores with audio_emotion, offline with no token, cgo in standalone module, runtime CGO-free
Snippets compile and Open succeeds with WithClassifier and with a registered factory
Registered providers emit inference.call.completed / inference.call.failed events and inference_* metrics
